name: A Gun Is Just a Tube

description.value:
Requirement Any object roughly the size of a forearm.

Whatever you are holding is now a firearm. It uses your best weapon proficiency, deals damage as a martial firearm of a type you choose, never fails, and lasts until the end of the encounter or until you make one of these out of something else. You may Hot Load it, and it explodes on a Blow Up result exactly as satisfyingly as you would hope.
